annotations.title: Embed a Threads profile or post

description: Embed code (HTML) for a Threads PROFILE, showing the name, picture, bio, follower count and a Follow button, or for a post, to put on a website. url is https://www.threads.com/@name/ (or just @name) or a post link; theme light (default), dark or auto; maxWidth 320-658. Private, age-restricted or embed-disabled accounts cannot be embedded. Read-only, free.
